Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 293)

Changes since build 288.

Build 293: Bookmark folder fixes

  • The bookmark folder dropdown no longer leaves extra space under the last row.
  • Delete on a bookmark folder now removes the folder with all its bookmarks and subfolders, and asks first when it holds bookmarks.

Build 292: Glass bookmark folders in the browser

  • Bookmark folders open as a glass dropdown inside the browser, under the folder, never over the sidebar.
  • The bookmarks bar follows the sunset theme.
  • Edit Bookmark and Bookmark Manager use the system glass look instead of navy.
  • Faster, smoother folder opening: folder lists are cached and favicons show at once.

Build 291: HTTPS by default and bookmark folders

  • The browser opens plain http:// pages over https unless the host is in Settings › Browser › HTTP Hosts (typed addresses, links and redirects such as email tracking links). A site with no working https, or one that redirects back to http, shows a short message pointing to HTTP Hosts.
  • Browser import builds a real folder tree under “Imported from <Browser>” in the browser's order, and moves bookmarks you already had into it. Re-import changes nothing.
  • Folder pickers show the folder tree (full path when closed, “Bookmarks Bar (top level)” root), and the bookmark right-click menu has Move To.

Build 290: Chrome account bookmarks

  • Browser import now finds Chrome bookmarks of a signed-in Google account (AccountBookmarks). Before, they showed as “Not found”.

Build 289: Non-Latin shortcuts and browser import

  • Cmd+V, Cmd+C, Cmd+W and other Cmd shortcuts now work on Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew and other non-Latin keyboard layouts. Limitation: a Ghostty config binding written as super+<Cyrillic letter> now needs the Latin letter.
  • Browser import lets you pick Sign-ins, Bookmarks and History per browser (Chrome-family, Firefox, Safari).
  • Bookmarks are imported into an “Imported from <Browser>” folder. History keeps the newest 500 pages.
  • Sign-ins start unchecked, so nothing sensitive is copied unless you choose it. Safari import needs Full Disk Access.
